title: Graphics has square around it
content:
I have loaded a graphic onto a garment but it seems to show a black background despite the graphic being a PNG with a transparent back ground. I have ensured the graphic has the same normal map as the fabric. Would appreciate any tips on how to avoid this. ![9fd94833079c4980a19f41a9a9c2a0ba](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/0b7abb48abae4df5828382b864b5c723/images/9fd94833079c4980a19f41a9a9c2a0baCaptureLogo.PNG)


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi there, it's a known bug and is currently being fixed.Please download a previous version of CLO (https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/0b7abb48abae4df5828382b864b5c723 Otherwise, some users mention that it can be resolved by activating the "Shadow Render" option in the graphic's property editor. Sorry for the inconvenience!
content_description: This web page aims to provide troubleshooting tips for resolving issues with PNG graphics displaying a black background on garments despite having a transparent background.

title: Curve point grading issue
content: Hello, after recent updates of the Clo, the grading for curved points have got weird. In some files they work properly, in others you have to convert them into grading points. It's that a program bug or a deliberate change? It is not comfortable when working.

title: clo problem
content:
Hello, has anyone experienced issues with the simulation feature in Clo3D for Mac? Since the latest update, the simulation option stops working and does not allow me to simulate my garment. The only way to make it work is by closing and reopening the software, and it only lets me simulate once. After that, I have to restart the program again in order to continue viewing the progress of my garment. Is there any known fix or workaround for this issue?


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: CLO3D simulation does not start consistently. In most cases, the simulation starts only after 3–4 attempts, or does not start at all, even with very simple garments constructed in 2D. The issue occurs during fitting and simulation preview.
Reply 1: Hi, please check your specs against the system requirements https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/8e89e258c0be4b6ebf1f6c18fea48aa4 If you are using windows, could you check if your GPU is set to high performace? https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/8e89e258c0be4b6ebf1f6c18fea48aa4 Please get back to us if this helps.

Comment 2: Hi There. We are sorry to hear you are having this issue. Please send in a ticket direct to our Tech Support teamhttps://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/8e89e258c0be4b6ebf1f6c18fea48aa4
content_description: This webpage aims to gather insights and solutions from users experiencing simulation issues with Clo3D on Mac following the latest update.

title: Notches not exporting
content:
I can no longer export notches on PDFs. It's been this way for a few versions now, I'm on the latest version and it still doesn't work. I've been exporting notches on pdfs for 5 years now, and now it no longer works. And yes I have notches checked in the export settings modal. Please fix this asap, I need notches on pdfs for work.

![02e75635160f4392b77b4d52d800cac3](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/bd0c3a32c7464593a7450e4e7d7a74c8/images/02e75635160f4392b77b4d52d800cac3Screenshot%202025-11-20%20223929.png)Notches in working project

![5a1dc1da1d644cc1a05d25a336fe64ba](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/bd0c3a32c7464593a7450e4e7d7a74c8/images/5a1dc1da1d644cc1a05d25a336fe64baScreenshot%202025-11-20%20223941.png)Export Settings

![d155bb2d73384da0af009cb8f1ca4271](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/bd0c3a32c7464593a7450e4e7d7a74c8/images/d155bb2d73384da0af009cb8f1ca4271Screenshot%202025-11-20%20223955.png)No trace of them in Illustrator.


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: I have the same issue with the notches in clo. In recent versions I had to copy and paste pattern pieces to be able to export them in pdf, but in lates version they appear incorrect.

Comment 2: Hi There. We wanted to let you know our Internal Tech team received your ticket that you also sent in. They will be looking at it as soon as they are able to and will follow up with you there.Please know that as it is Friday they may not get to it before the weekend. So it is likely you may not hear back till early next week.If you need the notch feature we may recommend down grading to 2025.1 till next week.
content_description: This webpage aims to address the issue of exporting notches on PDFs that has been malfunctioning for several versions, impacting users' workflows and necessitating a prompt fix.
